resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1956; the Forest Lookouts Idaho inventory gives the same year but says only gone. The date agrees; no source gives a cause.

notes_for_editor: Built and destroyed dates agree across the three pages. Staffing rests on one page (Idaho Fire Lookouts, 1940 to 1943, George Terrien). The Forest Lookouts Idaho inventory credits its dates to Kresek; the cached page shows only the attribution '(Kresek)'. A search summary said the inventory credits Kresek's book, which the page itself does not spell out, so it is not repeated in the story. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page carries a 'Courtesy: The Fire Lookout Museum' photo credit and firelookout.com a 'Photo courtesy the Fire Lookout Museum' note, but no image URL was captured, so no photo is added. No source describes the site or patrol point today. Brief record: no correction needed.
